app/sales/service.py:116-220 reverse_invoice_atomic is append-only: return movements carry reverses_movement_id and the AR credit_note carries reverses_entry_id; active-receipt guard prevents reversal of paid invoices; original header/lines/VAT/posting metadata retained and the row flips to Voided.

app/finance/payments.py:52-110 create_receipt and :163-223 void_receipt derive customer/branch from the locked invoice, guard overpayment against grand_total under the invoice row lock, and append an AR adjustment linked to the original payment entry.

app/finance/payment_router.py:74-260 enforces WRITE_ROLES={owner,finance}, the POSTING_ENABLED gate, invoice/receipt version checks, active void/reversal reason validation, and scope via the linked invoice.

alembic/versions/0010_invoice_collections.py supplies the DB backstops: uq_receipt_branch_no, uq_invoice_receipt_scope, uq_ar_invoice_sale, uq_ar_receipt_type, uq_stock_invoice_line_sale, ck_receipt_amount_positive/method/status/void_metadata/version, ck_invoice_posting_actor, and the guard_terminal_invoice / guard_terminal_line / guard_append_only / guard_receipt_history triggers.

Genuine independent-session races: race() asserts len(pids)==2 distinct PostgreSQL backend PIDs behind a Barrier(2) (test_invoice_cycle_safety.py:3517-3541), covering duplicate post/reverse/receipt-void, overcollection, shared-stock contention and reverse-vs-collect.

Stale invoice/receipt versions are rejected with 409 (test_stale_financial_versions_are_rejected, 3 cases) and repeated terminal operations return 409 (test_full_cycle steps 9, test_concurrent_financial_operations).

Disposable-DB isolation is enforced by the autouse fixture (tests/conftest.py:1572-1592) and by verify_invoice_cycle.py creating/removing a fresh dms_cycle_test_* database with before==after binding hashes.
No hardcoded secrets, credentials, network, subprocess, eval, exec or pickle in the 17-file delta; the only runtime configuration is the env-driven flag (app/config.py:5-13).

All SQL is parameterized via sqlalchemy.text() with bound values; column identifiers are fixed literals (app/finance/ar.py:85-88, app/inventory/service.py:127-135, app/finance/payments.py:136-144) - a minor observation is recorded separately, not a vulnerability.

Input validation is enforced by Pydantic: InputModel extra='forbid' plus str_strip_whitespace; ReceiptIn amount gt=0 with max_digits=14/decimal_places=2 and allow_inf_nan=False; method pattern ^(cash|check|transfer)$; receipt_no min_length=1 max_length=30; invoice_version strict int ge=1 (app/finance/schemas.py:58-68, app/sales/schemas.py:9-11).

Forged/extra fields are rejected: test_receipt_rejects_malformed_or_forged_fields (12 cases) includes status, customer_id, branch_id and created_by as extra forbidden fields -> 422, proving client-supplied financial authority cannot be injected.

RBAC: _role verifies is_active, role membership and the is_owner flag in payment_router.py:42-50, sales/router.py:34-42 and finance/router.py:35-39; session expiry and active-user check live in auth/router.py:44-58.

Territory/branch scope is revalidated at posting time (test_posting_revalidates_source_grant, 404 after grant removal) and at receipt-read time (test_managers_receipt_reads_require_branch_and_territory, test_collection_list_respects_territory_revocation).

Database-level immutability is enforced by triggers: guard_append_only on finance.ar_entry and inventory.stock_movement, guard_terminal_invoice/line on sales, guard_receipt_history on finance.payment_receipt; 8 raw UPDATE/DELETE statements are rejected (test_raw_financial_history_is_immutable).

Duplicate posting, duplicate receipt number, overpayment and concurrent mutations are prevented under the invoice row lock combined with unique constraints; test_concurrent_financial_operations (6 cases) resolves to {200,409}/{201,409} with correct persisted final state.

findings.finding: Void/reversal reason liveness (is_active + category) is validated before the invoice row is locked. A concurrent deactivation between that check and the write can persist an ar_entry/receipt void_reason_id pointing at an inactive reason_code; the DB FK only checks existence, not is_active. Same pattern at app/sales/router.py:444 for reversal.

void_receipt issues its own SELECT CURRENT_DATE round-trip inside the service to date the compensating AR adjustment instead of accepting the date from the caller; reverse_invoice_atomic does the same at app/sales/service.py:203. Functional, but it mixes a DB round-trip into a service helper.

_lock_invoice(db, existing['invoice_id']) is called for its locking side-effect and its return value is ignored (the comment documents intent). Harmless, but the router already holds the invoice lock, so the call is redundant within void_receipt.

_filters builds column identifiers by f-string from a fixed literal whitelist (warehouse_id/product_id/batch_id/movement_type) with bound values, consistent with the documented convention; a stricter SQL-safety posture would assert the identifier against an explicit allowlist at runtime. Same pattern in app/finance/ar.py:85-88 and app/finance/payments.py:136-144.
